fact: 1914年6月28日上午11时15分，奥匈皇储弗朗茨·斐迪南大公与其妻索菲在波斯尼亚首府萨拉热窝乘车时，被波斯尼亚塞族青年加夫里洛·普林齐普开枪打死。奥匈总参谋长康拉德·冯·赫岑多夫与外交大臣贝希托尔德把此案视为压制塞尔维亚、挽回帝国在巴尔干威望的机会。

sources.title: Encyclopaedia Britannica, Austria-Hungary: The outbreak of war
sources.quote: At 11:15 am on June 28, 1914, in the Bosnian capital, Sarajevo, Franz Ferdinand and his morganatic wife, Sophie, duchess of Hohenberg, were shot dead by a Bosnian Serb, Gavrilo Princip. The chief of the Austro-Hungarian general staff, Franz, Graf (count) Conrad von Hötzendorf, and the foreign minister, Leopold, Graf von Berchtold, saw the crime as the occasion for measures to humiliate Serbia and so to enhance Austria-Hungary’s prestige in the Balkans.

fact: 1914年7月23日18时，奥匈驻贝尔格莱德公使吉斯尔向塞尔维亚外交部递交限48小时答复的最后通牒，共十项要求：查禁反奥出版物、解散「民族自卫」组织、清除教材中的反奥内容、撤换奥方指名的军官与官员、允许奥方机构在塞境内协助镇压颠覆活动、由奥方代表参与刺杀案的司法调查、逮捕坦克西奇少校与齐加诺维奇、制止军火走私并惩办边防守卫、解释敌视奥匈的官员言论、立即通报执行情况。吉斯尔本人得到的指令是「无论塞尔维亚如何答复，你都必须断绝关系，并且必须开战」。

sources.title: 1914-1918-online. International Encyclopedia of the First World War, July Crisis 1914
sources.quote: Hopes that an amicable solution might be found were dashed at 6 p.m. on 23 July, when the Austrian Minister in Belgrade, Wladimir Giesl (1860-1936), delivered a forty-eight-hour ultimatum to the Serbian Foreign Ministry ... Baron Giesl, the Austro-Hungarian Minister in Belgrade, had been charged with issuing the ultimatum, and instructed: “However the Serbs react to the ultimatum, you must break off relations and it must come to war.”

sources.title: HistoryCentral, Austria Declares War on Serbia（通牒十项要求英文全文）
sources.quote: It contained ten demands: 1. to suppress every publication which shall incite to hatred and contempt of the Monarchy ... 10. to inform the Imperial and Royal Government without delay of the execution of the measures comprised in the foregoing points.

fact: 1914年7月25日，塞尔维亚在48小时期限内答复，接受多数要求，但对「由奥方指名撤换塞方官员」与「奥方官员在塞境内参与审讯」两项提出保留，并提议交国际仲裁。奥匈当场拒绝，随即断绝外交关系并下令局部动员；吉斯尔率团撤离贝尔格莱德。

sources.title: Encyclopaedia Britannica, Austria-Hungary: The outbreak of war
sources.quote: Serbia replied to the ultimatum on July 25, accepting most of its demands but protesting against two of them—namely, that Serbian officials (unnamed) should be dismissed at Austria-Hungary’s behest and that Austro-Hungarian officials should take part, on Serbian soil, in proceedings against organizations hostile to Austria-Hungary. Though Serbia offered to submit the issue to international arbitration, Austria-Hungary promptly severed diplomatic relations and ordered partial mobilization.

sources.title: 1914-1918-online. International Encyclopedia of the First World War, July Crisis 1914
sources.quote: Forty-eight hours after he had delivered the ultimatum, Giesl and the rest of the Austrian delegation hastily left Belgrade. However, the Serbian response to the “unacceptable” ultimatum astonished everyone and was, in the words of Christopher Clark, a “masterpiece of diplomatic equivocation”.

fact: 1914年7月28日，奥匈在《维也纳日报》号外官方栏公布对塞尔维亚的宣战书，弗兰茨·约瑟夫一世当日在上奥地利的巴德伊舍签署《致我的人民》宣言；7月29日奥匈炮兵开始炮击贝尔格莱德。7月31日奥匈宣布总动员，8月12日越境进攻塞尔维亚。

sources.title: Library of Congress, Declarations of War from Around the World: Austria-Hungary, Kriegserklärung（Wiener Zeitung, 1914-07-28, Extraausgabe, 19）
sources.quote: On July 28, 1914, the Austrian-Hungarian government declared war on Serbia. The Declaration of War was published in French and German in a special edition of the Wiener Zeitung ... Kriegserklärung [Declaration of War], Wiener Zeitung, July 28, 1914, Extraausgabe, Amtlicher Teil, 19

sources.title: Encyclopaedia Britannica, Austria-Hungary: The outbreak of war
sources.quote: War was in fact declared on July 28, and Austro-Hungarian artillery began to bombard Belgrade the next day.

sources.title: Wikipedia, To my peoples（《致我的人民》宣言与总动员、入侵日期）
sources.quote: The document was signed by Franz Joseph and Karl von Stürgkh, minister-president of Austria. ... On July 29, Belgrade was bombed for the first time. On July 31, Austria-Hungary announced a general mobilization and, on August 12, the invasion of Serbia started.

fact: 1914年8月12日奥匈第五集团军从波斯尼亚北部渡过德里纳河进攻塞尔维亚，8月15日至24日在策尔山一带被塞军击退。塞军8月24日夺回沙巴茨；奥匈阵亡6000—10000人、伤约3万人、被俘约4500人，塞军阵亡3000—5000人、伤约1.5万人。这是协约国在第一次世界大战中的首场胜利，战役期间还发生了战争史上第一次空战缠斗。

sources.title: Wikipedia, Battle of Cer
sources.quote: Date 15–24 August 1914 ... The Serbian victory over the Austro-Hungarians marked the first Allied victory over the Central Powers in the First World War, and the first aerial dogfight of the war took place during the battle. ... Those of the Austro-Hungarians were significantly higher, with 6,000–10,000 soldiers killed, 30,000 wounded and 4,500 taken as prisoners of war.

sources.title: Wikipedia, Serbian campaign (1914)
sources.quote: Despite the incomplete concentration of the 5th and 6th Armies, the Austro-Hungarian forces launched their first offensive into Serbia on 12 August.

fact: 与法国「全国戒严」不同，奥匈把戒严限定在划为「战区」的边境省份，内地仍由民政管理；在战区，军事当局可控制交通、通信与财产，集会、言论与隐私权被中止或严格限制，平民可被送交军事法庭，而「危害国家安全的罪名」界定含糊，军事当局有很大的裁量空间。

sources.title: 1914-1918-online. International Encyclopedia of the First World War, Martial Law（Steven R. Welch）
sources.quote: Russia, Austria-Hungary, and Italy took the second course, imposing martial law over extensive portions of their borderland regions that were designated as zones of war, while leaving interior zones under civilian control. ... In France, military authorities had the power to decide if civilians charged with offenses that allegedly threatened the security of the state or were deemed detrimental to the war effort would face military tribunals. The vagueness of the term “security of the state” gave military authorities great latitude

fact: 奥匈1912年的《战时给付法》（Kriegsleistungsgesetz）授权国家广泛干预经济：企业连同其雇员可被置于军事管理之下，转向军需供应。1914年10月10日的授权法令使物价管制、设立管制中心与配给卡合法化；12月10日颁布谷物与面粉最高限价；住户存面粉不得超过20公斤，以防抢购。

sources.title: Cahiers bruxellois, From the Brilliant Metropolis of a Great Power to the “Swelled Head” of a Rump State: Vienna in the First World War
sources.quote: There was, however, the Kriegsleistungsgesetz (War-Service Act) of 1912 providing for extensive intervention by the State in the economy. Businesses, including their employees, could be placed under military administration and oriented towards the supply of war needs. ... The enabling decree of 10th October, 1914 legitimised these state interventions in economic life ... on 10th December, 1914 maximum prices for cereals and flour were decreed ... heads of households were not allowed to keep reserves of more than 20 kg of flour.

fact: 1914年7月31日，奥匈银行因黄金与外汇储备消耗过快而停止出售金银与外汇，事实上终止了金本位；8月4日的帝国法令进一步中止纸币兑金、40%黄金覆盖率要求与每十日公布资产负债表义务，并允许奥匈银行突破禁令向政府放贷。1914年7月流通中的克朗为34亿，生活成本指数以该月为100。

sources.title: Deutsche Bundesbank, Geldgeschichtliche Nachrichten 341（引 Oesterreichische Nationalbank 货币史）
sources.quote: Aufgrund des raschen Verbrauchs von Gold- und Devisenreserven stellte die Oesterreichisch-ungarische Bank deren Abgabe bereits am 31. Juli 1914 ein und beendete damit faktisch den Goldstandard.

sources.title: IMF, The Dissolution of the Austro-Hungarian Empire: Lessons for Currency Reform（1992）
sources.quote: On August 4, 1914, the Austro-Hungarian government suspended gold conversion, the need for 40 percent gold cover of the currency, and the obligation to publish central bank statements every ten days, and authorized the Austro-Hungarian Bank to ignore the prohibition from lending to the government.

sources.title: European Center of Austrian Economics Foundation, A short summary of the Austrian hyperinflation after WWI
sources.quote: In July 1914, the Monarchy’s currency in circulation stood at 3.4 billion Crowns ... The cost of living index, at 100 in July 1914 has risen to 1.640 by November 1918.

fact: 1914年维也纳一公斤上等小麦面粉44赫勒（heller），一公斤黄油3.20克朗，一枚鸡蛋9赫勒。到1918年秋，同一种面粉的官方限价涨到2.76克朗、黑市价30克朗，黄油官方价20.60克朗、黑市120克朗；官方价格在战争期间上涨约十倍，黑市涨幅远超十倍。

sources.title: Die Welt der Habsburger, Managing the shortages
sources.quote: If one kilogramme of flour still cost 44 hellers (Austrian currency) in 1914, by autumn 1918 the regular price for the same had soared to 2.76 crowns. At the same time, the kilogramme was traded on the black market for 30 crowns. A similar price progression emerged with animal products: here the regular price for a kilogramme of butter rose from 3.20 crowns to 20.60 crowns, while the illicit market price hit 120 crowns meanwhile. If an egg could be purchased at the beginning of the war for 9 hellers, by autumn 1918 the same item was traded on the black market for 40 crowns.

sources.title: Cahiers bruxellois, Vienna in the First World War
sources.quote: From October there was a scarcity of flour in Vienna; flour from then on had to be eked out. The Kaisersemmeln (Emperor rolls), Kipferl (croissants) and pretzel sticks so beloved of the Viennese were replaced from the beginning of February 1915 by the so-called Kriegsbrot

fact: 奥匈军队在1914年7月28日夜至29日炮击贝尔格莱德时使用了斯柯达（Škoda）305毫米臼炮；这种重炮是帝国少数能在开战初期立即投入的攻城火力，也代表奥匈军工（斯柯达、斯太尔）在战争初期的技术位置。

sources.title: Wikipedia, Serbian campaign (1914)
sources.quote: A Škoda 305 mm mortar used by the Austro-Hungarian army to fire on Belgrade ... At 5 am, Habsburg artillery in Bežanija and Semlin also began shelling the city and Kalemegdan using Krupp Howitzer and Skoda 305 mm mortars.
